label: siderophore production
definition: A physiological trait in which bacteria biosynthesize and release siderophores that scavenge extracellular iron for uptake.
observations: Broad organismal siderophore biosynthesis and release trait; absent from live METPO except for METPO:1000277 obsolete siderophore, and distinct from siderophore transport or a molecule-level siderophore class.
